events.title: Vicente Yáñez Pinzón lands on the coast of Brazil
events.description: The Spanish navigator, who had captained the Niña under Columbus, landed near Cape Santo Agostinho in today's Pernambuco. He arrived three months before Cabral, but Brazil fell within Portugal's sphere.

events.title: First Fleet raises the British flag at Sydney Cove
events.description: Captain Arthur Phillip established a penal colony at Sydney Cove with some 1,300 convicts, marines and officials. The date is marked as Australia Day, and by many Indigenous Australians as a day of mourning.
events.html: Captain Arthur Phillip established a penal colony at Sydney Cove with some 1,300 convicts, marines and officials. The date is marked as Australia Day, and by many Indigenous Australians as a day of mourning.

events.title: Michigan becomes the 26th US state
events.description: Michigan joined the Union after giving up the disputed Toledo Strip to Ohio, the cause of the bloodless 'Toledo War'. In exchange it received most of the Upper Peninsula.
events.html: Michigan joined the Union after giving up the disputed Toledo Strip to Ohio, the cause of the bloodless 'Toledo War'. In exchange it received most of the Upper Peninsula.

events.title: Cullinan diamond, the largest ever found, discovered
events.description: Mine manager Frederick Wells found a 3,106-carat rough diamond at the Premier Mine near Pretoria. Cut into nine major stones, it supplied the largest gems in the British Crown Jewels.
events.html: Mine manager Frederick Wells found a 3,106-carat rough diamond at the Premier Mine near Pretoria. Cut into nine major stones, it supplied the largest gems in the British Crown Jewels.

events.title: Germany and Poland sign a non-aggression pact
events.description: Hitler's Germany and Piłsudski's Poland agreed a ten-year declaration of non-aggression. It loosened Poland's ties with France; Hitler renounced it in April 1939 and invaded that September.
events.html: Hitler's Germany and Piłsudski's Poland agreed a ten-year declaration of non-aggression. It loosened Poland's ties with France; Hitler renounced it in April 1939 and invaded that September.

events.title: India becomes a republic under its new constitution
events.description: The Constitution of India came into force and Rajendra Prasad became the first President, replacing the British monarch as head of state. The day is celebrated as Republic Day.
events.html: The Constitution of India came into force and Rajendra Prasad became the first President, replacing the British monarch as head of state. The day is celebrated as Republic Day.

events.title: Bill Clinton denies an affair with Monica Lewinsky
events.description: At the White House, President Clinton declared he 'did not have sexual relations with that woman'. He later admitted an inappropriate relationship and was impeached by the House in December 1998, then acquitted.
